title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 12.8 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9,…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 12.8 up to but not including 19.4.11, 19.5 up to 19.5.9, and 19.6 up to 19.6.2 allowed unauthenticated users to execute quick actions via Service Desk emails due to improper input sanitization. This issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
